title: FERRYMAN TAKES FAKES (V2)
description: The definitive reconstruction: the LP, its unreleased Procession Take and the V1 beat, sampled at 88 BPM; the LP's 7/8 crossing landing on the one after seven bars; a second line in D7; V1 at half speed; a cadence across two records.

tracks.description: The LP: the counterfeit cut (head-a bar 1 into bar 4), its feral twin from the shout, the coins.
The LP's whole 7/8 crossing, played straight across 4/4.
The LP's stop bar (on the one, after seven bars of 7/8) and its unresolved last chord.
Odile re-sung from her own syllables: the count, the rap, octave dives, a fifth bent up; her last breath.
The viewing-room bell two octaves down, at the convergence.
Iggy's break kick (LP bar 8, beat 1) at its own speed, its punch above 58 Hz; below that belongs to the Deacon.
Iggy's break snare, laid back; its ghost as parade presses and climbs.
The break snares above 6.5 kHz: the wires and the room, cut to a sixteenth.
Iggy's conga roll, one hand at a time.
The Procession Take: the dirge, the press roll and shout, the second line, the shout chorus sinking, the F major home.
Brother Ezra: the riff alone, then stacked into a horn section of one man (unison, a fourth up, an octave down).
FERRYMAN TAKES FAKES V1, sampled as an old record: its shout at half speed, then at its own.
The eternal Deacon: his one plucked F, spliced to last forever, played as the bass with 808 glides.
Reversed slices of the LP: the bell inhaling into the convergence, the shout downbeat swelling into V1.
